parsed.post: Massive improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 with all shards (0-10) dropped val_bpb from 0.8927 to 0.8635. Capacity boost is clearly working. Next, I'll test halving the TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to see if more optimizer steps within the 5-minute budget can drive this further down.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH to 6 and reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 to increase optimizer steps.
